### WhatsApp Webhook Receiver & AI Agent Router

**Functions & Features:**
- **POST /whatsapp-message-trigger**: Intercepts inbound WhatsApp replies.
- **Lookup & Switch**: Searches user roles and routes to greeting templates.
- **DSE/DSO AI Agent**: Routes to a secure LLM pipeline with aggregated database context.
